title: Engine response to operation fuzz (/io/response.json)
description: Stage 4, deterministic fuzzing of the changed public functions with a fixed seed. Each finding is an input that raised an error the engine did not expect, with the seed that reproduces it. runs and seconds say what the budget bought.

input.description: The input as the engine reproduces it.

unsupported.description: Changed public functions the engine could not fuzz (untyped or unsupported signatures), each with the reason. Optional: absent when every function was fuzzed. It lives here, not in a side file, so response.json is the only output the core reads.
